That's a broad problem. You also have field-specific problems. But most are somehow touched by the publish-or-perish paradigm in some way. A lot of people enter the scientific tracks and tenured jobs are both lucrative but highly competitive.

I think there are multiple cultural forces at play here, but in general science has become a rat race.
